title: Veritux
extract:
The Veritux is a massive Archmelee telescopic sword with massive damage but slow attack speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high attack range (143.00 m)
High total damage (470)
Disadvantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Possesses delay between combo looping, hindering attack speed.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (5.00%)
Very low attack speed (0.833x animation speed)
Very low damage × attack speed (401.29)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Veritux (Normal Attack), compared to  Prisma Veritux (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage (470.00 vs. 394.00)
Higher  Impact damage ( 70.5 vs.  59.1)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 70.5 vs.  59.1)
Higher  Slash damage ( 329 vs.  275.8)
Higher total damage (470 vs. 394)
Lower base critical chance (5.00% vs. 30.00%)
Lower base critical multiplier (1.50x vs. 2.00x)
Lower base status chance (10.00% vs. 20.00%)
Lower attack speed (0.833x animation speed vs. 1.000x animation speed)
Lower Mastery Rank required (0 vs. 8)

Acquisition
A built Veritux is automatically acquired upon claiming the Odonata Archwing from the Foundry during The Archwing quest.
Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for  100,000.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Trivia
The Veritux was tentatively known as the Imspartacus in demo videos, referencing the line "I'm Spartacus" from the 1960 movie Spartacus.
The name Veritux was most likely taken from the Latin word Veritus meaning "to revere or respect" or "to fear" depending on context.
